title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; analysts weigh AI trade shift
summary: Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned, and Yorkville Ives cut its price target on the chipmaker to $225 from $300 while keeping a buy rating, with shares closing the week at $162.85. On CNBC&\#x27;s "ETF Edge," Roundhill&\#x27;s Dave Mazza and Yorkville Ives&\#x27; Dan Ives argued other Big Tech and AI chip names could gain if investors lose confidence in Nvidia, and Ives estimated a Democratic-controlled Congress could prevent 10% to 20% of planned data centers from being built.
